sentence: GLP-1 receptor agonists are medicines that imitate GLP-1, a hormone the body releases after eating.
note: GOV.UK (imitates GLP-1 released after eating; fuller for longer) and NHS tirzepatide page (reduces appetite, fuller for longer, delays stomach emptying), via search summaries.

sentence: Semaglutide (Ozempic, Wegovy, Rybelsus) is one; tirzepatide (Mounjaro) is described on the NHS website as acting on both GIP and GLP-1 receptors.
note: GOV.UK (imitates GLP-1 released after eating; fuller for longer) and NHS tirzepatide page (reduces appetite, fuller for longer, delays stomach emptying), via search summaries.

sentence: In the UK they are used to manage type 2 diabetes and to treat obesity.
Semaglutide imitates GLP-1, helps people feel fuller for longer and reduces hunger, according to GOV.UK.
note: GOV.UK (imitates GLP-1 released after eating; fuller for longer) and NHS tirzepatide page (reduces appetite, fuller for longer, delays stomach emptying), via search summaries.

sentence: Tirzepatide is described by the NHS as reducing appetite so that people feel fuller for longer, and it delays stomach emptying.
note: GOV.UK (imitates GLP-1 released after eating; fuller for longer) and NHS tirzepatide page (reduces appetite, fuller for longer, delays stomach emptying), via search summaries.

sentence: Feeling sick, being sick, diarrhoea and constipation are common with semaglutide, and tirzepatide is described as commonly causing feeling sick, indigestion, constipation and diarrhoea
note: NHS Cheshire and Merseyside tirzepatide statement: feeling sick, indigestion, constipation, diarrhoea common; NHS semaglutide: sick, diarrhoea, constipation.

sentence: Pancreatitis is listed by the NHS as a rare but serious effect of semaglutide, and UK prescribing information says acute pancreatitis has been reported with tirzepatide, including necrotising and fatal cases
note: UK tirzepatide SmPC (emc) via search summary: acute pancreatitis reported, incl. necrotising and fatal post-marketing cases; NHS semaglutide: pancreatitis rare but serious.

sentence: Severe stomach pain that does not go away needs urgent advice from NHS 111 or the GP the same day, and a 999 call if it is severe or the person is collapsing
note: Site signposting rule (999 / NHS 111 or GP same day). Route wording not stated in retrieved text; plain textbook triage.

sentence: The MHRA advises against GLP-1 receptor agonists in pregnancy because of a lack of human safety data, and advises effective contraception during treatment
note: NHS SPS: MHRA advises against GLP-1 RA in pregnancy and contraception throughout treatment, lack of human safety data.

sentence: The MHRA has highlighted a potential risk of stomach contents entering the lungs during general anaesthesia or deep sedation, because these medicines delay stomach emptying and food can remain despite fasting
note: MHRA Drug Safety Update (title and summary): delayed gastric emptying may increase risk of residual gastric contents despite fasting; potential risk of pulmonary aspiration under general anaesthesia or deep sedation.

sentence: With semaglutide, low blood sugar is more likely when it is taken with other diabetes medicines such as insulin or a sulfonylurea
note: MedlinePlus lists dizziness, sweating, shakiness, fast heart rate as low blood sugar symptoms; NHS/SmPC: more likely with insulin/sulfonylurea.

sentence: The MHRA advises effective contraception during GLP-1 receptor agonist treatment because human safety data in pregnancy are limited.
note: NHS SPS: MHRA advises against GLP-1 RA in pregnancy and contraception throughout treatment, lack of human safety data.
